using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Amazon.DynamoDBv2;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Orleans.Configuration;

namespace Orleans.Storage
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Configuration options for DynamoDBGrainStorage.
    /// </summary>
    public class DynamoDBStorageOptions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the name of the DynamoDB table.
        /// </summary>
        public string TableName { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the AWS service.
        /// </summary>
        public string Service { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the AWS access key.
        /// </summary>
        public string AccessKey { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the AWS secret key.
        /// </summary>
        public string SecretKey { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the AWS session token.
        /// </summary>
        public string Token { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the AWS profile name.
        /// </summary>
        public string ProfileName { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the read capacity units for the DynamoDB table.
        /// </summary>
        public long ReadCapacityUnits { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the write capacity units for the DynamoDB table.
        /// </summary>
        public long WriteCapacityUnits { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether to use provisioned throughput.
        /// </summary>
        public bool UseProvisionedThroughput { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether to create the DynamoDB table if it does not exist.
        /// </summary>
        public bool CreateIfNotExists { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether to update the DynamoDB table if it already exists.
        /// </summary>
        public bool UpdateIfExists { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the time to live for the grain state.
        /// </summary>
        public TimeSpan? TimeToLive { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the service id.
        /// </summary>
        public string ServiceId { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets a value indicating whether to delete the state on clear.
        /// </summary>
        public bool DeleteStateOnClear { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets or sets the init stage.
        /// </summary>
        public InitStage InitStage { get; set; }
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Orleans.Storage;
using System;

public class DynamoDBGrainStorageFactoryTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Create_WithValidServiceProvider_ReturnsDynamoDBGrainStorage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        var optionsMonitorMock = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<DynamoDBStorageOptions>>();
        var optionsMock = new Mock<IOptions<DynamoDBStorageOptions>>();

        optionsMock.SetupGet(o => o.Value).Returns(new DynamoDBStorageOptions());
        optionsMonitorMock.Setup(om => om.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(optionsMock.Object);
        serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(IOptionsMonitor<DynamoDBStorageOptions>))).Returns(optionsMonitorMock.Object);

        // Act
        var factory = new DynamoDBGrainStorageFactory();
        var grainStorage = factory.Create(serviceProviderMock.Object, "test");

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(grainStorage);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Create_WithInvalidServiceProvider_ThrowsException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
        serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetService(typeof(IOptionsMonitor<DynamoDBStorageOptions>))).Returns(null);

        // Act and Assert
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => new DynamoDBGrainStorageFactory().Create(serviceProviderMock.Object, "test"));
    }
}
